banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Fail owned regional origins/dependencies; distinguish proxy observations from full-region guarantees.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Validate detection, alternate capacity, data availability, and client recovery against the agreed interruption budget.
sourceAcceptance: Detection, surviving capacity, transaction outcomes, and client recovery meet the declared budget where evidenced; full-region claims are not fabricated.
sourceQualification: D-S114 requires unplanned owned-origin/dependency isolation and regional recovery orchestration. This lesson changes only fixed fictional teaching DATA, never actual resources, networks or processes.
preconditions: Open the complete folder directly in a JavaScript-capable browser.
Teaching North and Teaching South, their two origin labels each, profile-store and order-log are fictional.
The declared workload is 80 capacity units, required data revision is 7, and the agreed interruption budget is an integer from 10 through 120 authored seconds.
actions: Choose a fixed fixture, typed budget, and origins/dependencies/both data fault.
Isolate Teaching North as in-memory data only.
Sample authored detection and shallow proxy observations.
Check measured alternate capacity and required data before fictional selection.
Sample getProfile session recovery and confirmOrder total effects, then compare total interruption with the budget.
Inspect retained history; repeat up to six runs or explicitly reset.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Every origin, dependency, fault, region, proxy, recovery, transaction, session and journey is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: Isolation labels leave detection and continuity UNKNOWN.
96 surviving capacity units, accessible revision 7, exactly one order effect and session recovery in 30 seconds pass only the ready fixture at budget 60.
Capacity 50, unavailable revision 6, duplicate order effects, or 75 seconds at budget 60 are measured negatives.
Shallow healthy HTTP without bounded dependency-aware, capacity, state and client evidence remains UNKNOWN.
An unconfirmed transaction is not inferred lost or committed.
Full regional continuity is always UNKNOWN; fixtures and sampled proxies cannot certify an actual Azure-region outage.
Typed input, bounded authentic state replay and action-order guards reject invalid requests without mutation.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, reset, startup-failure and CSP observations accompany focused tests.
limits: No actual resource, network, process, regional outage, routing, dependency or transaction operation.
No clock, randomness, server, remote data, credentials, identity, deployment, packages, framework or spending.
History is in memory and ends only on explicit reset or reload.
B-S114 and D-S114 remain incomplete; a positive A rehearsal is not native evidence or a regional guarantee.
Node 22.23.4 is local test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 with installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 and the published isolated helper only; the inactive lifecycle prototype is unqualified.
Individual browser observations do not qualify the helper as an unattended lifecycle-recovery runner.

verification.normalVerification: Read-only. Only exact deliberate CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 writes browser evidence.
